items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: The interviewer addresses 'Ralph' directly ('Do you have anything, Ralph, that you could... Want to ask about?'), indicating Ralph is the interviewer or a third party present, not the subject of the interviewee's personal narrative. The interviewee's preceding story about 'he' refers to an unnamed i

ctx.x: No, we didn't have that anymore. Just a... Just a nice card. Yes. And he used to fix them for me all the time. He was very good to me, too.

Well, we're just about out of tape here. And that's some other question that... Do you have anything, Ralph, that you could... Want to ask about? No, I don't think so. Is there anything else that you wanted to tell us? I think you've told us your whole life now pretty well, as originally. Can you tell me something I put it in? Yes, it's very fine. I'm just sorry I didn't have those letters for sure going on.
Well, that's alright. I understand what those letters are. You might come back again, you know. I might just send them an hour. Oh, yeah. Yeah. Someday we'll try to see your time. Yeah.
